name: io.github.bimwright/ipt-mcp
description: MCP gateway for Autodesk Inventor 2022-2027 (parts, sketches, features, parameters, iProperties, mass properties, export).

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to run the server in strict read-only mode (write/send_code toolsets are not registered).

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable (meta,query,document,parameters,properties,sketch,feature,export,code,toolbaker,toolbaker_write); 'all' enables every known toolset.

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_ENABLE_SEND_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1/true to expose the dangerous inventor_send_code tool (also requires BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_PLUGIN_ENABLE_SEND_CODE=1 on the add-in).

environmentVariables.name: BIMWRIGHT_INVENTOR_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Pin the active target by 4-digit Inventor year (e.g. 2025) or descriptor id.
